_summary.alternatives: More optimistic summary rejected because it would understate practical mapping risk; more pessimistic summary rejected because direct structural evidence is strong.
_summary.uncertainty: Remaining uncertainty is concentrated in implementation detail, not basic export existence or broad domain presence.
_summary.decision: Summary set to balanced “usable but partial” characterization.

overall.summary: Practice Fusion EHR exposes a broad native TSV export model with strong structural coverage and current documentation, making migration technically feasible. The main limitations are documentation-quality gaps (no sample payloads, no explicit FK/value-set/constraint catalogs) and boundary uncertainty for downstream payments/claims and some binary document delivery details.

notableFacts: Vendor documentation states manual export supports both single-patient and entire-practice population workflows in TSV format.
The parsed v9 dictionary documents 85 TSV entities and 1,165 fields with field names, types, and descriptions.
Lab coverage is highly decomposed (orders, items, diagnoses, specimens, results, observations, notes, and documents).
Billing content is detailed at superbill level but does not clearly document full downstream claim adjudication/remittance/payment posting lifecycle.
No sample TSV payload files are included in the captured public artifact set; only schema/documentation artifacts are present.
Documentation shows active versioning through v9 published on 2026-01-12.
